## Change

Describe the feature and the user-visible result.

## Validation

- [ ] Build, TypeScript and ESLint pass.
- [ ] Relevant business and permission tests pass.
- [ ] Desktop and mobile behavior reviewed if the interface changed.
- [ ] New database changes use a new migration; previous migrations are unchanged.

## Release considerations

State environment changes, database compatibility, and rollback implications. Distinguish live service verification from isolated tests.
